propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL with identical unmet-criteria counts) on identical inputs within minutes without intervening code changes, making the close gate unreliable in both false-blocking and false-passing directions.

The verifier's non-determinism is narrowly concentrated in test-existence crediting: it marks acceptance criteria unmet by claiming required tests do not exist when they are present in the tree, with verdict flipping between runs (proven on ad9f and 4de6 tickets).

The root cause is the agent's variable, fallible free-form search strategy: it issues semantic/regex queries (which take literals as regexes and fail) instead of ticket-id and exact-symbol lookups via search_files, leading to spurious 'no test found' conclusions.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar does not persist verified_at_sha, trace_id, or resolved input context, preventing stored data alone from proving input-identity and distinguishing genuine flakes from input drift.
Temperature remains unpinned (not set to greedy/0), preserving sampling variance that modulates which search strategy the agent lands on and indirectly flips test-existence judgments.

The completion verifier's agent-facing guidance does not document that search_files is literal case-sensitive substring search, nor advises searching by ticket-id and list_directory before concluding test absence.
